title: US-China talks on trade, AI between Trump, Xi beckon
summary: The presidents of the world's two largest economies are in Washington for what Donald Trump has billed a "big day." Bilateral trade, AI and geopolitics are all on the menu. Follow DW for the latest.

image.caption: Thursday's talks are set to culminate in a state banquetImage: Saul Loeb/AFP

blocks.text: Trump, First Lady welcome Xi, Madame Peng at White House

blocks.caption: The leaders met outside the White House late on Thursday morningImage: Saul Loeb/AFP

blocks.text: China's President Xi Jinping and his wife have arrived at the White House to being Thursday's talks.
They were greeted by US President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump on the South Portico of the White House late on Thursday morning.
